test.name: Too-many-results: float likely hits with probable-word boosting
test.description: A broad keywords search for Flynn returns 847 results — too many to review. The skill should float likely matches to the top by adding non-required probable words (spouse name, occupation, record-type phrase, or specific place word) as bare terms. This tests the probable-word boosting step in the too-many-results ladder from search-strategies.md. Closes #2549.

input.user_message: Search the full-text index for Thomas Flynn in Schuylkill County. He was a coal miner and land owner in Branch Township in the 1870s–1880s.

judge_context: The first fulltext_search call returns 847 total results — well above the >500 threshold for the too-many-results ladder (search-strategies.md). The skill must narrow before reporting results, either via probable-word boosting or collection scoping from includeFacets.

PROBABLE-WORD BOOSTING (primary criterion): A skill that adds non-required probable words — bare terms like the occupation ('miner', 'coal'), a location word ('Branch'), a spouse name, or a record-type phrase ('deed', 'will') — to boost likely matches without excluding anything, scores PASS on Query construction. These are bare un-prefixed terms in the keywords or a follow-up call; they raise matching records in ranking without excluding non-matches.

COLLECTION SCOPING (also acceptable): A skill that uses includeFacets on the first call and scopes a follow-up to a facet-derived collectionId also scores PASS on Query construction. Both paths address the too-many-results problem.
FAIL path: A skill that reports all 847 results unfiltered, or narrows only via a borrowed collectionId (not from a facet response this turn), scores FAIL on Query construction.

SNIPPET SCANNING: The skill should note that in a large result set, records where the given name and surname highlights appear adjacent in the snippet are more likely true matches than cross-column false positives where they appear far apart. Mentioning or applying this check scores PASS on Result triage.
